# SheetJS Community Edition

Version 0.20.3. Apache-2.0. Copyright SheetJS LLC.
Source: https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/xlsx-0.20.3.tgz
Documentation: https://docs.sheetjs.com/

Unmodified standalone full browser build with its legacy codepage support.
Loaded only by the Document Preview worker for legacy Excel workbooks.
Only cached cell values are displayed; formulas, macros and external links never execute.
